title: International World Wide Web Conference Committee
text:
Members of the IW3C2 are ordinary members, ex officio members, non-voting members, and officers.[1]

### Ordinary members

Ordinary members are elected for a period of 3 years during a general meeting. Members are nominated due to their recognition in the WWW community and represent themselves. Members can be re-elected only after at least one year of absence.[1]

The following are the founding members at the time when IW3C2 was officially incorporated in May 1996:[1]

Jean-François Abramatic

Tim Berners-Lee

Robert Cailliau

Dale Dougherty

Ira Goldstein

Joseph Hardin

Tim Krauskopf

Detlef Krömker

Corinne Moore

R. P. Channing Rodgers

Albert Vezza

Stuart Weibel

Yuri Rubinsky (died prior to incorporation)

### Ex officio members

Ex officio members are selected from the immediate past conference general co-chairs and from future conference co-chairs. Their term expires one year after the conference they organized. Ex officio members can be elected as ordinary members.[1]

The following are current (April 2016) ex officio members and the conference with which they are affiliated:

Jacqueline Bourdeau - WWW2016

James Hendler - WWW2016

Rick Barrett - WWW2017

Rick Cummings - WWW2017

Laurent Flory - WWW2018

Fabien Gandon - WWW2018

### Officers

The IW3C2 officers consist of a chairperson, a vice-chair (chairperson-elect), a secretary, a treasurer, and other appointees. Officers are elected during a general meeting (usually at the annual WWW conference) and serve for one year. They can be re-elected an indefinite number of times.[1]
